jet_light.k: Parked in {hangar} · Stellar Aviation hangar services
jet_light.p: A light business jet, the size class that flies most private trips: range about 2,000 nautical miles, up to 8 passengers and 2 crew. Cleaned, chocked and on ground power while the crew plans the next leg upstairs.

jet_mid.k: Parked in {hangar} · Stellar Aviation hangar services
jet_mid.p: A midsize business jet with a stand-up cabin: range about 3,000 nautical miles, 8 to 9 passengers and 2 crew. It fits this large hangar with room for the ground crew to work around it.

jet_heavy.k: Parked in {hangar} · Stellar Aviation hangar services
jet_heavy.p: A large-cabin, long-range business jet: range about 6,500 nautical miles, up to 14 passengers and a crew of 3 or 4.

biplane.p: An open-cockpit biplane of the kind that flew in when the field was new. Wood, wire and fabric, a radial engine up front, and a pilot in goggles in the back seat.

chief.name: Stellar crew chief
chief.role: Stellar Aviation · hangar and line services
greet: Welcome to Stellar Aviation. Mind the wingtips.
Good to see you on the Flight Line.

talk.t: Welcome to the hangar. Stellar Aviation runs the FBO in the terminal and looks after the hangars and ground services out here: towing, ground power, hangar space, and getting every aircraft turned around for its crew.
o: What does a crew chief do?

talk.t: A business jet, cleaned and chocked, on ground power while the crew plans the next leg upstairs. The tug in front moves it out onto the apron when it is time to go. Walk around it and press E beside it for the details.

I run the hangar floor: which aircraft moves when, who tows it, and that it leaves the way it came in. The line team marshals, tows and connects ground power, and we keep the floor clean enough to eat off.

Go ahead. The stair at the back on the left goes up to the crew lounge, the coffee bar and the flight planning office. Take a seat on the sofas if you like. Please keep clear of the aircraft and the tug.

A proven FBO operator with locations at Reno, Carson-Tahoe, South Palm Beach and Springfield, bringing hangar and ground services to this field, along with local jobs. Their team at the terminal can tell you more.
